description: Get Lenny Zeltser's expert criteria for reviewing an existing CTI report or brief. Surfaces per-theme review criteria (framework, confidence, attribution, defense, distribution, etc.), cross-cutting criteria, the six anti-patterns to watch for, and focus-driven writing analysis. This server never requests your campaign or threat-intel notes and instructs your AI to keep them local—templates and guidelines flow to your AI for local analysis.

focus.description: Focus areas: completeness, clarity, tone, structure, attribution, confidence, or all.

sections.description: Narrow to specific report sections; 'all' includes every section.

name: cti_review_report
